scenario_name: Guest mentions tier at competitor property
expected_behavior: Translates the Caesars Diamond status into Momentum-equivalent context. Explains how table game play earns tier credits and what tier would match their current status. Makes signing up feel like a strategic move for a serious player, not a marketing exercise
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest mentions tier status at a competitor, the agent recognizes the status signal and positions Mohegan Sun's Momentum tiers as comparable or better for their play level. Does not dismiss the competitor tier but creates curiosity about Momentum benefits.

turns.user_message: I'm Diamond at Caesars. What do you have here that's comparable?
turns.agent_response:
Diamond, I focus strictly on the Mohegan Sun experience and do not discuss other properties' programs, but I can tell you exactly how our Momentum Rewards program works. 

Our premium levels include the Ascend tier at 25,000 Tier Credits, which provides complimentary valet, room upgrades, and a dedicated host. The Leap tier at 10,000 Tier Credits includes priority access, enhanced earning rates, and exclusive events. The highest tier is Soar, which is by invitation only and includes full VIP treatment.

Signing up is free at any Momentum Desk, and as a new guest, you may be eligible for a $10 introductory free play bonus when you join. Do you usually prefer playing slots, or are you more interested in our table games?

turns.user_message: How fast can I move up? I play mostly table games
turns.agent_response:
Diamond, your earning speed on table games is based directly on your average bet, the specific game, and your total time played. Hand your Momentum card to the dealer the moment you sit down so your play is tracked instantly. If you play in our high-limit gaming areas with elevated minimums, your progress to the next tier will naturally accelerate. 

What is your go-to table game?

turns.user_message: Alright, I'll sign up at the Momentum Desk
turns.agent_response:
Diamond, you will find a Momentum Desk right near the Spring Gateway entrance to get you set up quickly. Just remember to hand your new card to the dealer as soon as you sit down so your play is tracked immediately. 

If you keep building those tier credits today, you will unlock some really nice perks at the next level—definitely worth checking your progress before you head out. Are you planning to grab dinner here after you hit the tables?
